Former Colleague Testifies in Alan Jones Assault Trial

A former colleague of Australian broadcaster Alan Jones testified in court that Jones indecently assaulted him on eight occasions in 2008. The complainant, referred to as 'Complainant C', also alleged he was 'groomed for 10 years' by Jones. Jones has pleaded not guilty to 22 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching involving six men. The cross-examination of the complainant was described as combative.
